tool_args.rationale: The pilot covers only H≤0.48, whereas the target is H=20. The authorized mechanism and probe guidance both identify a potentially reversing slow adaptation component, requiring long-horizon observations before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter sink-coupled dual-horizon law from pilot rows alone
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five short-horizon rows do not identify the slow adaptation timescale or reliably predict at H=20.
Long-horizon discrimination is more directly relevant to the target forecast.
It does not resolve the temporal identifiability ambiguity.
